# Ranker ceiling: classical candidate generators on the provisional split

Recall@K is the ceiling of any reranker that only reorders a fixed top-K list. hit@20 = share of users with ≥ 1 relevant asset in the top-20. 'top-20 random / oracle order' = nDCG@10 after shuffling / ideally reordering the generator's own top-20 (lower and upper bound for a reranker of that list). nDCG@10 columns by number of distinct assets bought before the cut. Provisional split, not official.
